text:
Anna L.: quick one — we're lining up the 13:00 release window, there's a migration to analytics in the same corridor. who wants this slot? (i'm juggling infra reviews)
Michael P.: I can take the slot but need a quick heads-up: has the migration DB toggle landed? PR #4821?
Jen K.: yeah PR #4821 merged this morning, migration toggle gated behind `feature.analytics_migration` flag. tests green except one flaky e2e in search that i filed a follow-up for.
Tony R.: if Michael is doing the slot i'll own rollback plan + post-deploy validations. what are our canary gates?
Sarah C.: i can run the smoke checklist and perf sanity after canary. ping me when canary is live.
ops-bot: Deploy ticket created: INF-2026-1337 — staging -> prod path, canary slice 10%. Auto-escalate to oncall if error_rate > 1% in 5m.
Anna L.: ok michael + tony + sarah sounds good. michael — plan: canary -> 10m observation -> full rollout. rollforward plan if KV mismatch or >1% errors in canary.
Michael P.: noted. i'll trigger canary at 13:05 to avoid overlap with another team's 13:00 DB vacuum. using slot 7. command i'll run: `rdeploy run --svc analytics-api --slot 7 --mode canary --pct 10`
Jen K.: small note — the service env var `ANALYTICS_MIGRATION_MODE` defaults to `passive` so the toggle is safe. watch logs for `migration: activation` in the first 30s.
Tony R.: rollback checklist: 1) scale-down new canary pods 2) flip `feature.analytics_migration` back to `false` 3) redeploy previous replica set `rev: 20260215-9` 4) run quick smoke `curl -sSf /health || true` and notify infra.
Sarah C.: i'll be in lobby when canary starts. my smoke script:
```
# quick smoke
curl -sS --fail https://analytics.example.com/health
python tools/check_response_samples.py --sample 50 --assert-no-regressions
```
Anna L.: tiny timing tweak — michael, start canary at 13:07 (give vacuum + backups time). confirm when you schedule.
Michael P.: ack, scheduling for 13:07. i'll post a start message + canary logs.
ops-bot: Reminder: add rollback tag `rollback-ready: true` to the ticket before starting deploy.
Michael P.: added tag. ticket updated.
Jen K.: FYI i'm leaving my laptop open for 13:00-13:30 in case of stray rollbacks. :coffee:
Tony R.: i'll be on call 13:00-14:00 for this window. if anything looks off, i'll execute rollback plan and DM the release list.
Sarah C.: canary watchlist: latency p50/p95, error_rate, top 5 slow endpoints. i'll send metrics link when canary starts.
Anna L.: perfect. last check: do we need any db migration backout steps? Jen?
Jen K.: migration is additive with zero-downtime toggle. backout is just flipping the feature flag off and rolling back pods — covered.
Michael P.: starting canary in ~10m. will paste logs and metrics.
Sarah C.: ready on my side.
Anna L.: thanks team — preflight tetris solved. tagging owners: @Michael P., @Tony R., @Sarah C. go time at 13:07. :rocket:
